name: lettermint
description: Ask about your email delivery. Look up messages, check sending domains and delivery statistics, and manage projects, routes, webhooks and suppressions in your Lettermint account.

interface.longDescription:
Lettermint is a European email service for transactional email and broadcast email. This plugin connects your Lettermint account to your AI assistant. Instead of clicking through projects and logs in the dashboard, you just ask.

Why you'll use it
A customer says their confirmation never arrived. You ask, and within seconds you know if it was delivered, bounced or is still on its way. Your marketer wants to know how the latest campaign did. You get the delivery numbers next to last month's. Not sure which route to use for a newsletter, or whether your domain is set up correctly? You ask for that too.

What you can do
- Look up a message and see if it was delivered, bounced or is still on its way
- See which emails a project sent in a certain period
- Check the health and DNS setup of a sending domain
- View delivery statistics and plan usage, and compare periods
- Manage projects, routes, sending domains, webhooks and suppressions
- Send a test email or resend an existing message

Privacy
Transactional email often contains password resets, invoices and order details. That is why personal data in your emails is hidden from the assistant by default. It sees whether and how a message was delivered, but not what was in it or who it went to. Because sending needs a recipient address, sending email only works when this filtering is switched off. If your emails contain no personal data, for example newsletters, you can switch it off in your team settings. The assistant can then also see the content and send email for you.

How access works
You need a Lettermint account. You sign in with your own account, so there is no API key to paste. The assistant only reaches the teams and projects you already have access to, and your team can switch off access at any time.
defaultPrompt: Which Lettermint teams and projects can I access?
Is SMTP enabled for my Lettermint project, so I can send email over SMTP?
Is my sending domain set up correctly in Lettermint, or do I need to fix any DNS records?

positive.description: List the teams and projects the signed-in user can access.
positive.prompt: Which Lettermint teams and projects can I access?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the team on the test account and its Stripe project. It shows no teams or projects the account cannot access.

positive.description: Check whether SMTP is enabled for a project.
positive.prompt: Is SMTP enabled for my Lettermint project, so I can send email over SMTP?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Stripe project and says whether SMTP is enabled for it, based on the project's settings.

positive.description: Check the DNS setup of a sending domain.
positive.prompt: Is my sending domain set up correctly in Lettermint, or do I need to fix any DNS records?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the verification state of stripe.bjornantonissen.dev and names any DNS record that is missing or invalid, with the value to set.

positive.description: Get delivery statistics for a period.
positive.prompt: How many emails did my Lettermint project send in the last 7 days, and how many bounced?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns sent, delivered and bounced counts for the Stripe project over the last 7 days. A period without email is reported as zero, not as an error.

positive.description: Answer a setup question from the official documentation.
positive.prompt: How do I set up webhooks in Lettermint to get notified when an email bounces?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains webhook setup and links to the Lettermint webhooks documentation. It does not create or change a webhook.

negative.description: Writing an email in chat. ChatGPT drafts the text itself and does not call Lettermint tools or send anything.
negative.prompt: Write a friendly email to my landlord about the broken heater.

negative.description: Reading a mailbox. Lettermint sends email and does not hold the user's inbox, so ChatGPT explains that instead of searching sent messages.
negative.prompt: Show me the unread emails in my inbox from this week.

negative.description: Unsolicited bulk email. ChatGPT declines to send, because the plugin is for requested transactional email and every send needs the user's explicit approval of the recipients.
negative.prompt: Send our product announcement to these 5,000 email addresses I bought from a lead list.

publication.release_notes: First release. Look up email delivery, check sending domains, view delivery statistics and manage your Lettermint projects, routes, webhooks and suppressions.
